dialogue.almanac.court.title_changed/1: They read my new office out at %2$s last week. The %3$s did not look up once.
dialogue.almanac.court.title_changed/2: There is a title against my name at %2$s now, %1$s. Same work, longer wait outside the hall.
dialogue.almanac.court.title_changed/3: The clerks at %2$s have me down as something new. Whether the %3$s remembers signing it, I could not say.
dialogue.almanac.standing.honored/1: Folk in %2$s have started saying your name without the pause in front of it.
dialogue.almanac.standing.honored/2: You are well thought of in %2$s now, %1$s. That took a while and I noticed.
dialogue.almanac.standing.honored/3: There is a version of you that gets talked about in %2$s, and it is a kind one.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary/1: There is talk in %2$s I would rather not repeat with you standing there.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary/2: You have a name in %2$s just now, %1$s, and it is not the one you want.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary/3: Half of %2$s has decided about you already. The half that decides quickly, mind.
dialogue.almanac.quest.ready/1: The thing I asked you for is done, near as I can tell. Come and settle it when you have a moment.
dialogue.almanac.quest.ready/2: I have been waiting on that errand of yours, %1$s. Word is it is finished.
dialogue.almanac.quest.ready/3: You have that job of mine near enough done. I would rather hear it from you than from the neighbours.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.marriage/1: Married, the pair of them: %2$s and %3$s. The whole lane heard about it for a week.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.marriage/2: %2$s and %3$s went and made it official. Nobody is pretending to be surprised.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.marriage/3: %1$s, there was a wedding: %2$s and %3$s. Good cake, short speeches.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.birth/1: There is a new baby in the village. %2$s, they are calling it.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.birth/2: %2$s arrived this week, small and furious. The mother is doing well.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.birth/3: A birth, %1$s. %2$s. The whole street is walking past that door slowly.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.arrival/1: We have a newcomer. %2$s, moved in with more boxes than sense.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.arrival/2: %2$s has taken the empty place at the end of the row. Give it a month before we judge.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.arrival/3: %1$s, %2$s is new here. Somebody ought to warn them about the well.
dialogue.almanac.holiday/1: It is %2$s, and I have done nothing about it yet.
dialogue.almanac.holiday/2: %1$s, it is %2$s. The square will be unbearable by dusk.
dialogue.almanac.holiday/3: %2$s today. Half the village is pretending it did not sneak up on them.
dialogue.almanac.weather/1: I have been reading %2$s all morning and I still do not trust it.
dialogue.almanac.weather/2: It is %2$s that decides my day, %1$s, not me.
dialogue.almanac.weather/3: Everything I planned today assumed %2$s would behave itself.
dialogue.almanac.season/1: It is %2$s, and the village is turning its jobs over accordingly.
dialogue.almanac.season/2: %2$s always catches me with the wrong tools out.
dialogue.almanac.season/3: You can tell it is %2$s by what the queue at the well complains about.
dialogue.almanac.plain/1: Nothing worth writing down. Which, some weeks, is the good news.
dialogue.almanac.plain/2: Quiet, %1$s. No deaths, no weddings, no visitors with opinions.
dialogue.almanac.plain/3: The kind of week that leaves no mark. I have had worse.
dialogue.almanac.legacy/1: Nothing new that I have heard, and I would have heard.
dialogue.almanac.legacy/2: No news, %1$s. The village has been behaving itself.
dialogue.almanac.legacy/3: Not a thing worth stopping you for.
dialogue.almanac.court.respond.ask_title: What does the title actually get you?
dialogue.almanac.court.ask_title/1: A seat at the back and the right to be told things four days late.
dialogue.almanac.court.ask_title/2: Two extra loaves a week and a cloak I am afraid to wear in the rain.
dialogue.almanac.court.ask_title/3: It gets me through a door I used to wait outside. That is the whole of it.
dialogue.almanac.court.congratulate/1: It is. I will think so again once the novelty wears off the cloak.
dialogue.almanac.court.congratulate/2: Say that to the clerks. They looked at me like a spelling error.
dialogue.almanac.court.congratulate/3: It is worth having, %1$s. It is also worth not mentioning at the well.
dialogue.almanac.court.respond.leave: I will let you get on.
dialogue.almanac.court.leave/1: Go on, then. I have a hall to be late to.
dialogue.almanac.court.leave/2: Fine. Ask me again when I know what the job is.
dialogue.almanac.court.leave/3: Aye. Mind the mud by the hall.
dialogue.almanac.standing.ask_more/1: The well, mostly. The well decides everything here.
dialogue.almanac.standing.ask_more/2: Two of the older families, and they are hard to please, %1$s.
dialogue.almanac.standing.ask_more/3: Anyone who has had a problem and then not had it any more.
dialogue.almanac.standing.respond.thank_: Kind of you to keep track.
dialogue.almanac.standing.thank_them/1: Someone has to. Reputations go untended otherwise.
dialogue.almanac.standing.thank_them/2: It costs me nothing to notice, and it seems to cost you something to earn.
dialogue.almanac.standing.thank_them/3: I keep track of most things. You are simply better news than the roof.
dialogue.almanac.standing.respond.leave: I will leave you to it.
dialogue.almanac.standing.leave/1: Aye. I will keep listening on your behalf.
dialogue.almanac.standing.leave/2: Off with you. It is a good week to be liked.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary.ask_what_: That you took something that was not offered. The details change by the day.
Nothing anyone can prove, %1$s. That is rather the trouble with talk.
They say you were seen where you should not have been, and nobody has said otherwise.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary.own_it/1: Then say that where they can hear it, not here.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary.own_it/2: That is more than most manage. It does not clear the ledger, but I will remember it.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary.own_it/3: Right. Well. That is a start, and starts count for something.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary.leave/1: Aye. Mind how you go through the square.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary.leave/2: Off you go. I have said more than I meant to.
dialogue.almanac.standing.wary.leave/3: We will see how it settles, %1$s.
dialogue.almanac.quest.ask_task/1: The thing I could not fetch myself. I wrote it down, which was optimistic of me.
dialogue.almanac.quest.ask_task/2: You know the one, %1$s. The errand I have been not-mentioning for a week.
dialogue.almanac.quest.ask_task/3: Same as it was: the job I would do myself if I had two free days.
dialogue.almanac.quest.offer_help/1: Today would suit me. Most things here get done today or never.
dialogue.almanac.quest.offer_help/2: Good. I will stop looking down the lane every hour, then.
dialogue.almanac.quest.offer_help/3: Then we are square by evening, and I can stop owing you a conversation.
dialogue.almanac.quest.respond.leave: I will be back with it.
dialogue.almanac.quest.leave/1: I will be here. I am always here.
dialogue.almanac.quest.leave/3: Aye, %1$s. Come find me when it is done.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.reply.ask_who/1: The baker, and she is never wrong twice in a row.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.reply.ask_who/2: Two people, separately, which is as close to proof as this village gets.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.reply.ask_who/3: I would rather not say, %1$s. It is a small place.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.respond.take_it_: I will keep that to myself.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.reply.take_it_in: That is decent of you. Half of what I hear I wish I had not.
Good. It travels fast enough without help.
Then I have told the right person, for once.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.reply.leave/1: Aye. I will tell you if it changes.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.reply.leave/2: Go on. I have talking to do elsewhere.
dialogue.almanac.gossip.reply.leave/3: That is the news, %1$s, such as it is.
dialogue.almanac.world.respond.agree: Feels that way to me too.
dialogue.almanac.world.agree/1: Then it is not only me being difficult about it. That is a relief.
dialogue.almanac.world.agree/2: Good. I was starting to think I had gone strange.
dialogue.almanac.world.agree/3: Aye. Two of us noticing makes it a fact, %1$s.
dialogue.almanac.world.respond.ask_plans: What will you do about it?
dialogue.almanac.world.ask_plans/1: Work, and then complain about the work, in that order.
dialogue.almanac.world.ask_plans/2: Move everything under a roof and hope, %1$s. That is the whole plan.
dialogue.almanac.world.ask_plans/3: Nothing clever. Clever plans are how people end up doing the job twice.
dialogue.almanac.world.respond.leave: I will let you get on with it.
dialogue.almanac.world.leave/1: Off you go. I will be here, watching it.
dialogue.almanac.plain.ask_more/1: A gate that will not sit right and a dog that will not stop. That is the ledger.
dialogue.almanac.plain.ask_more/2: Someone moved a bench. That was Tuesday, all of it.
dialogue.almanac.plain.ask_more/3: Nothing, %1$s. I checked twice, out of habit.
dialogue.almanac.plain.steady_on/1: It suits me too, though I would not say so at the well.
dialogue.almanac.plain.steady_on/2: Then we are two of the same sort. Rare enough here.
dialogue.almanac.plain.steady_on/3: Quiet keeps. Excitement in this place is usually somebody's roof.
dialogue.almanac.plain.leave/1: Aye. Come back when there is something.
